gloss: the face one shows to outsiders; manner toward strangers

definitions.gloss: the face one shows to outsiders; public manner
definitions.explanation: How a person behaves toward people outside the family or close circle. Usually in {外面|そとづら}がいい (pleasant to outsiders), which often implies the person is less pleasant at home.

examples.english: My brother is all charm with outsiders.

examples.japanese: {外面|そとづら}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{気|き}にしている→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: He only cares about how he looks to others.
My father is pleasant enough to other people, but at home he hardly says a word.

notes:
Informal and slightly critical. The same kanji read がいめん means the outer surface of a thing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {外面|そとづら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: nice to outsiders (but not at home)
- {外面|そとづら}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: only nice on the surface

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{建前|たてまえ}→建前：06621_tatemae⟧: the official stance one presents, as opposed to ⟦{本音|ほんね}→本音：06620_honne⟧
- ⟦{愛想|あいそう}→愛想：07292_aisou⟧: friendliness, affability
- {内弁慶|うちべんけい}: the opposite type, bold at home and timid outside
